title: The Hero's Rib
overview: A boy is struck by a meteor and reincarnates as a rib.

title: Hermit Crab / Right Door to the Demon King's Castle
overview: After coming back from being a rib, the protagonist moves on to more ridiculous reincarnations.

title: Clocktower Second Hand / Voice in the Hero's Head that Tells Him When He's Leveled Up
overview: A boy continues his reincarnation journey as he becomes a spell-casting clock hand and a rapping RPG voice.

title: Vegetable / The Lock on a Treasure Chest
overview: The protagonist continues his ridiculous reincarnations, this time as a vegetable and a treasure chest lock.

title: The String Tying the Secret Ninja Scroll / The Awkward Feeling Felt By a Single Man in the Background When There's a Couple Kissing in Front of Him
overview: The main character is reincarnated as a sticky scroll and an awkward feeling.

title: The Bomb You Use to Make Happy Couples Explode / A Descendant of the World Tree, Who Engages in a Fierce Struggle For Survival With Beavers
overview: The protagonist reincarnates as an exploding banana peel and a tree with legs.

title: The Torch on a Dungeon Wall / The Pillowcase at an Inn Where the Hero of a Dungeon Isekai Story Stays
overview: The rest of the multiverse discusses how to deal with the protagonist's antics.
